description: A Daemon of protocol 0.2 that is not its major's pick refuses the Kennel's hello at 0.1 and marks the refusal as a handover, then closes, as it does before it stops and starts the pick.

error.message: This Client speaks protocol 0.1, and this engine speaks 0.2: it accepts 0.2 only.

data.fix: Connect again once the Daemon has handed over to its major's pick.
